title: Reject native Windows batch dotfiles named exactly .cmd or .bat after path normalization
outcome: Reject native Windows batch dotfiles named exactly .cmd or .bat after path normalization
acceptance: Explicit-path and PATH regression cases cover .cmd, .bat and their trailing-dot/space spellings without executing an admitted batch shim.
The raw and resolved native-launch batch checks reject case-insensitive .cmd/.bat suffixes even when the basename is a dotfile.
